function searchRegistry(query, limit?): Promise<SFRegistryRecord[]>

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/registry.ts:227

Incremental registry search — pulls shards sequentially and collects records whose display name or catalogue designation contains the query (case-folded), stopping at limit matches so a "vega" search resolves in one shard while still scaling to the full catalogue.

Parameters

query

string

Substring to match (empty returns nothing).

limit?

200 = SF_STAR_CLOUD.SEARCH_LIMIT

Match cap (default 200).

Returns

Promise<SFRegistryRecord[]>

Matching records in shard order (brightest/alphabetical).
